segments.text: Two worlds. Identical messages. Can receiver B tell which world reports the wrong position? Look only at the information B receives.
Now reveal the true positions. In world two, the claim is eight meters ahead of the car. Yet B receives the same messages.
Both cars move three meters each second. Matching position changes do not prove that the reported position is correct. B needs independent evidence.
Try V two X Observation Lab. Create a lesson, reveal the evidence, and share the scenario. Synthetic examples, not a detector or safety verdict.
